label: INFORMATION ONLY: a simulation of the owner running these lanes on the 5-year history; not a rule, not a verdict
assumptions: each input signal bought at the next open (fractional shares), sold by its own rule: TRY SMALL rules at their lane hold (B-FCF1 63, DEC-FROG 126, ANOM-52WH 126, ANOM-RESMOM 63, ANOM-SUESURGE 60 sessions), CONF trades at their shortest input hold; stop at the next open after a close 15% under the buy (35% for 126-session holds)
slots full: the most liquid signal (20-session average traded value) first; a stock already held is not bought again
3 USD per buy and per sale + 0.8% cost on the money traded (stocks); funds: the same 3 USD fees + 0.1%
sameDollars = every buy of the strategy replaced by the same USD in the fund on the same buy and sale sessions; buyHold = the whole capital (slots x size) in the fund from the period start
months: change in (realized + open marks); drawdown on the daily marks; positions still open at the end are marked at the last close
NOT modelled: the ZAD halal filter of the real lane (history has no halal marks), the "switch off after 10 losing results" rule, taxes, dividends
